summary: Ryanair Holdings plc furnished a Form 6-K dated 3 November 2026 carrying only its October 2026 monthly traffic statistics. Guests rose 1% year-on-year to 19.4 million from 19.2 million, with load factor flat at 93% across roughly 109,100 flights; rolling twelve-month guests increased 5% to 215.4 million at a 94% load factor. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is a routine operating update for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation or risk-arb angle to watch.
